Step 0. Start of run.
Step 58014. Add light weight decay (0.02) to attention gate and router. https://github.com/marin-community/marin/issues/8818﻿
Step 81716. Improve EP implementation, 21->23 MFU and near-dropless. (Slightly lower train loss from less token dropping)
Step 108000. Improve datamix. (Slightly higher train loss from harder to predict dataset)
Step 108778. Disable PDL to work around intermittent hangs
Step 121638. Fix checkpoint crashing.
Step 146139. Native SM100 FA4 attention kernels and mask-free ragged expert MLP, 24->27 MFU.﻿﻿
